name: did-pretrend
source: Variant of the did fixture: the adopters' outcome drifts upwards before adoption (make_fixture.py in ../did), and the results carry no bound on violations of parallel trends. The did_results check must stop the run before drafting.
research_question: Did the units that adopted the policy see their outcome fall, compared with units that did not adopt it?
title: A staggered difference-in-differences evaluation with a pre-trend (synthetic)
